description: SYNTHORA ecb-forex-fixing-vs-market: Compare the official ECB daily EUR/USD reference fixing with a client-supplied USD-per-EUR quote, timestamp and provenance. Reports deviation in basis points and coverage/freshness gaps. The client quote is not independently verified. No live market quote is supplied or inferred; this commercial path does not redistribute open.er-api rates. [x402: 0.01 USDC per call on Base]

examples.market_provenance: SYNTHETIC DOCUMENTATION EXAMPLE; not a market observation; replace all quote fields before use

market_provenance.description: Required client-supplied quote provenance, at most 1000 characters and nonempty after whitespace trimming. Attribution is not independent verification or evidence of usage rights.
examples: SYNTHETIC DOCUMENTATION EXAMPLE; not a market observation; replace all quote fields before use

market_rate.description: Required positive finite USD per EUR quote supplied by the client, as a JSON number or decimal numeric string. Backend rejects booleans, nonnumeric, nonfinite, overflow and float-underflow-to-zero values. String positivity and numeric validity are checked by the backend.

market_timestamp_unix.description: Required client quote timestamp in Unix seconds UTC. Backend rejects booleans, unrepresentable dates and times more than 300 seconds in the future. Historical timestamps are accepted but age/coverage gaps may prevent a quality claim.

par.description: Only supported pair, EUR/USD; quote units are USD per EUR. Omission defaults to EUR/USD.

name: ecb_forex_fixing_vs_market
